info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Sale Update Management API enables businesses to modify existing sales records based on a unique identifier. This API supports updating key parameters of a sale, assisting in maintaining accurate sales data as circumstances change. Developers can utilize this API to integrate sales updates into their applications, ensuring real-time synchronization of sales information. Typical consumers include financial institutions and retail management systems that require dynamic adjustments to their sales records.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the sales support information for the specified product. You can modify relevant fields to ensure that the product details are current and accurate, supporting better sales management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the sales support details for the product identified by PROD-700045. The structure of the request body must align with the defined schema, ensuring that all required fields are included and properly formatted.
